mapper.select: SELECT id, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice FROM places WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, nickname, name, description, place_type AS placeType, allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, provides_yard AS providesYard, provides_walk AS providesWalk, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice FROM places WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_visible = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, host_user_id AS hostUserId, nickname, name, description, place_type AS placeType, area_size AS areaSize, capacity, allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, provides_yard AS providesYard, provides_walk AS providesWalk, other_options AS otherOptions, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, status, is_visible AS visible FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
